name: Kara Noir
source:
A treasure hunter, Kara Noir spends her days exploring ancient ruins in search of relics and artifacts. Outgoing and upbeat, she isn’t afraid to use her charm to get her way. Her independent and nomadic lifestyle has given her exposure to all types of personalities, and she is more than capable of taking on whatever life throws at her!

[From official website]
